title: hieracium bifidum subsp. dimorphophyllum
intro: Hieracium bifidum subsp. dimorphophyllum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a rare and unique flowering plant belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions include soothing and protecting the skin, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
